label: Exact binary error accounting for the third-factor chain (inference)
rule: Case analysis on three Booleans; measure of a symmetric difference; measure_sdiff_add_inter; ENNReal cancellation for finite values
meaning: Sharpness of the union bound for binary verdicts: the bound e1 + e2 is attained by the actual rates exactly when the error sets are almost surely disjoint, and any overlap lowers the judgment/truth error by twice its measure. For non-binary verdicts two errors need not cancel; this theorem does not cover them.
